Our Heritage & Partnership

About Bioque Estates International Pvt. Ltd.

Connecting India's premier developers in New Chandigarh and Tri-City with global ultra-luxury waterfront residences in Dubai.

Unmatched Advisory Across Flagship Corridors

Headquartered in Chandigarh on Madhya Marg, Bioque Estates International Pvt. Ltd. is a specialized luxury real estate advisory firm. We bridge the northern Indian luxury corridor—including Omaxe New Chandigarh, DLF, and Tri-City high-rises—with prime international real estate markets.

In exclusive partnership with Springfield Properties UAE, our advisory desk provides seamless transaction execution, site inspections, and portfolio management for NRI and high-net-worth investors looking to diversify into tax-free Dubai assets.

"Every development in our portfolio is selected based on developer delivery pedigree, architectural superiority, and capital appreciation potential."
